backtest.debug_summary: The cTrader console execution succeeded and produced a report JSON, but the strategy opened zero trades. This is a valid no-trade result, not a profitability result. Further ROI optimization is not meaningful until a diagnostic run confirms entries can trigger.

debug_next_steps: Run a diagnostic preset with relaxed filters to determine whether the zero-trade result is caused by strict strategy guards or by tick-delta not being populated under m1 data mode.
Suggested diagnostic toggles: lower DeltaThreshold, lower MinConfirmations, disable session-only overlap, disable HTF EMA filter, and set MinAtr to 0 for one short diagnostic run only.
If the diagnostic preset still produces zero trades, switch data mode or modify the delta source away from tick-only uptick/downtick counting for M1 backtests.
